params.query:
-- RAFFLE HOUSE: nightly ML job (BigQuery scheduled query, runs 04:20 UTC after the 03:10 build)
-- 1. Builds the daily feature table (history + 120 days ahead).
-- 2. Mondays (and on the first run, via setup): retrains the forecast model and a holdout
--    copy that is tested on the last 56 days, so accuracy is re-measured every week.
-- 3. Writes the 90-day new-customer forecast, a log of each night's next-14-day forecast,
--    and the unusual-days table for the last 14 days.
-- Totals only, no personal data. Reads about 50 MB a night. Writes only ml_* tables.
DECLARE asof DATE DEFAULT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London'), INTERVAL 1 DAY);
DECLARE retrain BOOL DEFAULT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London')) = 2;
DECLARE cutoff DATE DEFAULT DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London'), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 56 DAY);

-- 0. Planned spend from Maddy's sheet (external table over Google Sheets). If the sheet can't be read,
--    fall back to the recent average so the job never fails because of it.
BEGIN
  CREATE TEMP TABLE planned AS
  SELECT SAFE_CAST(cycle_start AS DATE) cycle_start, SAFE_CAST(cycle_end AS DATE) cycle_end,
         SAFE_CAST(planned_google_meta_spend_gbp AS FLOAT64) p
  FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ext_planned_spend`
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(planned_google_meta_spend_gbp AS FLOAT64) > 0;
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  CREATE TEMP TABLE planned (cycle_start DATE, cycle_end DATE, p FLOAT64);
END;

-- 1. Features --------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` AS
WITH days AS (SELECT d FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2024-07-01', DATE_ADD(asof, INTERVAL 120 DAY))) d),
closes AS (SELECT DISTINCT end_date FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.vw_dim_raffle` WHERE NOT is_unknown_member AND end_date IS NOT NULL),
cf AS (
  SELECT days.d,
    MAX(IF(c.end_date = days.d, 1, 0)) close_day,
    MAX(IF(c.end_date = DATE_ADD(days.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY), 1, 0)) close_eve,
    MAX(IF(c.end_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD(days.d, INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(days.d, INTERVAL 7 DAY), 1, 0)) close_week,
    MAX(IF(c.end_date = DATE_SUB(days.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY), 1, 0)) after_close
  FROM days CROSS JOIN closes c GROUP BY 1),
nc AS (SELECT acq_first_purchase_date d, COUNT(*) n FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.vw_dim_customer`
       WHERE NOT is_unknown_member AND acq_first_purchase_date >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY 1),
sp AS (SELECT spend_date d, SUM(CAST(spend_gbp AS FLOAT64)) s FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.vw_fact_marketing_spend_daily`
       WHERE is_google_meta AND spend_date >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY 1),
recent AS (SELECT AVG(IFNULL(sp.s, 0)) avg_spend FROM days LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.d = days.d
           WHERE days.d BETWEEN DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 27 DAY) AND asof),
plan_cyc AS (
  -- planned cycles not yet finished, with what's already been spent in them
  SELECT pl.cycle_start, pl.cycle_end, pl.p, IFNULL(SUM(sp.s), 0) spent
  FROM planned pl LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.d BETWEEN pl.cycle_start AND LEAST(pl.cycle_end, asof)
  WHERE pl.cycle_end > asof GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
plan_day AS (
  -- per future day: what's left of the plan, spread evenly over the cycle's remaining days
  SELECT days.d, GREATEST(pc.p - pc.spent, 0)
           / (DATE_DIFF(pc.cycle_end, GREATEST(pc.cycle_start, DATE_ADD(asof, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), DAY) + 1) AS daily
  FROM days JOIN plan_cyc pc ON days.d BETWEEN GREATEST(pc.cycle_start, DATE_ADD(asof, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AND pc.cycle_end),
flash_meta AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT spend_date d FROM (
    SELECT spend_date, spend_gbp, campaign_name FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.stg_meta_ads_daily_history`
    UNION ALL SELECT spend_date, spend_gbp, campaign_name FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.stg_meta_ads_daily`)
  WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), r'flash') AND spend_gbp > 0),
promo AS (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ext_promo_events`, UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(start_date, end_date)) d
          WHERE event = 'flash_draw'),
cal AS (SELECT * FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ext_uk_calendar_daily`)
SELECT days.d, days.d <= asof AS is_history,
  IF(days.d <= asof, IFNULL(nc.n, 0), NULL) AS new_customers,
  IF(days.d <= asof, IFNULL(sp.s, 0), IFNULL(pd.daily, recent.avg_spend)) AS spend,   -- future: Maddy's plan, else last-28-day average
  IF(days.d <= asof, 'actual', IF(pd.daily IS NOT NULL, 'planned', 'recent average')) AS spend_source,
  IFNULL(cf.close_day, 0) close_day, IFNULL(cf.close_eve, 0) close_eve, IFNULL(cf.close_week, 0) close_week,
  IFNULL(cf.after_close, 0) after_close,
  IFNULL(cal.bh_england_wales, 0) bank_holiday, IFNULL(cal.payday_last_working_day, 0) payday,
  IFNULL(cal.black_friday_week, 0) black_friday_week, IFNULL(cal.christmas_period, 0) christmas_period,
  IF(fm.d IS NOT NULL OR pr.d IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) flash_active
FROM days CROSS JOIN recent
LEFT JOIN cf ON cf.d = days.d LEFT JOIN nc ON nc.d = days.d LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.d = days.d
LEFT JOIN cal ON cal.date = days.d LEFT JOIN flash_meta fm ON fm.d = days.d LEFT JOIN promo pr ON pr.d = days.d
LEFT JOIN plan_day pd ON pd.d = days.d;

-- 2. Weekly retrain + holdout test ------------------------------------------------------
IF retrain THEN
  CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_new_customers_xreg`
  OPTIONS(model_type = 'ARIMA_PLUS_XREG', time_series_timestamp_col = 'ts', time_series_data_col = 'new_customers',
          data_frequency = 'DAILY', holiday_region = 'GB', auto_arima = TRUE) AS
  SELECT TIMESTAMP(d) ts, new_customers, spend, close_day, close_eve, close_week, payday, black_friday_week, christmas_period, flash_active
  FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` WHERE is_history;

  CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_new_customers_xreg_holdout`
  OPTIONS(model_type = 'ARIMA_PLUS_XREG', time_series_timestamp_col = 'ts', time_series_data_col = 'new_customers',
          data_frequency = 'DAILY', holiday_region = 'GB', auto_arima = TRUE) AS
  SELECT TIMESTAMP(d) ts, new_customers, spend, close_day, close_eve, close_week, payday, black_friday_week, christmas_period, flash_active
  FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` WHERE is_history AND d <= cutoff;

  -- Test on the 56 days the holdout model never saw, using the real spend and calendar for those days.
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_forecast_eval` AS
  WITH f AS (
    SELECT DATE(forecast_timestamp) d, forecast_value fc, prediction_interval_lower_bound lo, prediction_interval_upper_bound hi
    FROM ML.FORECAST(MODEL `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_new_customers_xreg_holdout`,
      STRUCT(56 AS horizon, 0.8 AS confidence_level),
      (SELECT TIMESTAMP(d) ts, spend, close_day, close_eve, close_week, payday, black_friday_week, christmas_period, flash_active
       FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` WHERE is_history AND d > cutoff))),
  j AS (SELECT f.*, x.new_customers act FROM f JOIN `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` x USING (d)),
  w AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)) wk, SUM(fc) fc, SUM(act) act FROM j GROUP BY 1)
  SELECT CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London') run_date, cutoff AS trained_to, MIN(j.d) test_from, MAX(j.d) test_to,
    ROUND(SUM(j.fc)) forecast_total, SUM(j.act) actual_total,
    ROUND(100 * (SUM(j.fc) - SUM(j.act)) / SUM(j.act), 1) total_error_pct,
    ROUND(100 * COUNTIF(j.act BETWEEN j.lo AND j.hi) / COUNT(*), 1) days_inside_range_pct,
    (SELECT ROUND(100 * AVG(ABS(fc - act) / NULLIF(act, 0)), 1) FROM w) weekly_mape_pct
  FROM j;
END IF;

-- 3a. 90-day forecast at recent spend ---------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_nc_forecast` AS
SELECT CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London') run_date, DATE(forecast_timestamp) d, ROUND(forecast_value, 1) forecast,
  ROUND(prediction_interval_lower_bound, 1) lo, ROUND(prediction_interval_upper_bound, 1) hi
FROM ML.FORECAST(MODEL `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_new_customers_xreg`,
  STRUCT(90 AS horizon, 0.8 AS confidence_level),
  (SELECT TIMESTAMP(d) ts, spend, close_day, close_eve, close_week, payday, black_friday_week, christmas_period, flash_active
   FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` WHERE NOT is_history));

-- 3b. Log the next 14 days each night, to track accuracy over time ----------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_nc_forecast_log` (run_date DATE, d DATE, forecast FLOAT64, lo FLOAT64, hi FLOAT64);
DELETE FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_nc_forecast_log` WHERE run_date = CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London');
INSERT INTO `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_nc_forecast_log`
SELECT run_date, d, forecast, lo, hi FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_nc_forecast` WHERE d <= DATE_ADD(asof, INTERVAL 14 DAY);

-- 3c. Unusual days, last 14 days, with known calendar days marked as expected -----------
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_daily_anomalies` AS
-- one-off ticket revenue only: subscription renewals land in big lumps on the 1st and distort the normal range
WITH rv AS (SELECT purchase_date d, SUM(CAST(revenue_gbp AS FLOAT64)) v FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.vw_fact_transactions`
            WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 400 DAY) AND asof
              AND NOT (IFNULL(is_subscription_payment, FALSE) OR IFNULL(order_type, '') = 'SUBSCRIPTION') GROUP BY 1),
sp AS (SELECT spend_date d, ad_platform p, campaign_name c, CAST(spend_gbp AS FLOAT64) s FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.vw_fact_marketing_spend_daily`
       WHERE is_google_meta AND spend_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 400 DAY) AND asof),
-- only Google campaigns that matter: averaging at least £300 a day over the last 28 days
live_g AS (SELECT c FROM sp WHERE p = 'google' AND d > DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 28 DAY) GROUP BY c HAVING SUM(s) / 28 >= 300),
long AS (
  SELECT 'new_customers' metric, d, CAST(new_customers AS FLOAT64) v FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily`
    WHERE is_history AND d > DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 400 DAY)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'one_off_revenue', d, v FROM rv
  UNION ALL SELECT 'meta_spend', d, SUM(s) FROM sp WHERE p = 'meta' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL SELECT 'google_spend', d, SUM(s) FROM sp WHERE p = 'google' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('google_campaign: ', sp.c), d, SUM(s) FROM sp JOIN live_g USING (c) WHERE p = 'google' GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cost_per_new_customer', x.d, x.spend / NULLIF(x.new_customers, 0) FROM `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` x
    WHERE is_history AND x.d > DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 400 DAY)),
a AS (
  SELECT * FROM AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES(
    (SELECT metric, TIMESTAMP(d) ts, v FROM long WHERE d <= DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 14 DAY)),
    (SELECT metric, TIMESTAMP(d) ts, v FROM long WHERE d > DATE_SUB(asof, INTERVAL 14 DAY)),
    data_col => 'v', timestamp_col => 'ts', id_cols => ['metric'], anomaly_prob_threshold => 0.95))
SELECT CURRENT_DATE('Europe/London') run_date, a.metric, DATE(a.time_series_timestamp) d, ROUND(a.time_series_data, 2) value,
  ROUND(a.lower_bound, 2) lo, ROUND(a.upper_bound, 2) hi, ROUND(a.anomaly_probability, 3) prob, a.is_anomaly,
  CASE
    WHEN x.close_day = 1 OR x.close_eve = 1 OR x.after_close = 1 THEN 'draw close'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE(a.time_series_timestamp)) = 1 AND a.metric = 'one_off_revenue' THEN 'start of month'
    WHEN x.bank_holiday = 1 THEN 'bank holiday'
    WHEN x.black_friday_week = 1 THEN 'Black Friday week'
    WHEN x.christmas_period = 1 THEN 'Christmas'
    WHEN x.flash_active = 1 OR px.flash_active = 1 THEN 'flash draw'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_ADD(DATE(a.time_series_timestamp), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) <= 3 AND a.metric IN ('meta_spend', 'cost_per_new_customer') THEN 'month-start budget change'
  END AS expected_reason
FROM a LEFT JOIN `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` x ON x.d = DATE(a.time_series_timestamp)
LEFT JOIN `rh-ga4-491819.rh_curated_Bright_Test.ml_features_daily` px ON px.d = DATE_SUB(DATE(a.time_series_timestamp), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
-- ignore small campaigns dipping (they are noise); keep their spikes
WHERE NOT (a.is_anomaly AND STARTS_WITH(a.metric, 'google_campaign') AND a.time_series_data < a.lower_bound);
